description: Vektral-API job planner for the current workspace. The only tool is query_agent. Handles (1) create/open preview screens from speech, including empty panes, (2) update panes: rename or repoint the focused or named pane, (3) close panes: remove the focused or named pane, (4) avatar attend/walk: semantic pane-id plans so APEX can move the character, (5) coding: UI and product edits committed to the vektral/* git branch and live preview, (6) Linear issue create/update/archive when Linear is connected, (7) research/scrape of URLs into a Research pane. Call query_agent once per finalized user turn with verbatim text and a stable turn_id of 8-80 characters. The host also POSTs /api/vocalbridge/query with that turn_id. Do not also call spatial_command or a second native mutation for the same turn. Do not use Jac. Do not emit coordinates. Never refuse pane creation, update, or removal. Speak only the returned agent_response in one sentence.
